caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a handled pan or colander with leg supports, rendered in grayscale on a light beige background. The main body of the pan is round and shallow, featuring ornate cut-out patterns along the upper edge and a second decorative band around the middle. Three curved legs attach to the base, lifting the pan off the surface, and three vertical handles are evenly spaced around the rim. Extending from one side is a large, dark, bulbous handle that tapers and features decorative carved ridges near its base. In the bottom right corner, there is a smaller, simplified line sketch that outlines the overall shape and proportions of the object, including the legs, handles, and long handle. The artist's signature and date appear in the lower left corner.
title: Silver Brazier
